figures.name: Sargon of Akkad

ability.name: World's Four Quarters
ability.description: Deal 3 damage to all enemies; all ally warriors gain +2 power from imperial glory.

figures.description: The world's first empire-builder whose legend of birth in a basket floating on a river inspired Moses's story.

figures.name: Ishtar (Akkadian)

ability.name: Gate of Ishtar
ability.description: Strip all buffs from one enemy as they pass through Ishtar's seven gates; deal 5 damage.

figures.description: The fierce Akkadian goddess who descended through seven gates, surrendering power at each, to save her lover.

figures.name: Shamash (Akkadian)

ability.name: Tablet of Laws
ability.description: All enemies must reveal their hidden abilities; they cannot act dishonestly for 2 turns.

figures.description: The Akkadian sun god who gave the laws to Hammurabi and inscribed them on the great stele for all to see.

figures.name: Sin (moon)

ability.name: Crescent Divination
ability.description: Predict one enemy ability; if correct, negate it automatically.

figures.description: The Akkadian moon god of Ur whose crescent illuminates the night and whose priests read divine messages in the sky.

figures.name: Nergal (Akkadian)

ability.name: Plague Star
ability.description: Deal 4 damage and plague one enemy: -2 HP per turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: Akkadian god of plague and death who rules the underworld alongside Ereshkigal after winning her love.

figures.name: Adad (Akkadian)

ability.name: Storm Omen
ability.description: Deal 3 damage to all; grant +2 power to storm allies from the tempest.

figures.description: The Akkadian storm god whose thunder and rain bring both destruction and the fertilizing rains.

figures.name: Pazuzu (Akkadian)

ability.name: Ward Against Evil
ability.description: Prevent one dark summoning; this card's terrifying face deters one enemy ability per turn.

figures.description: King of the wind demons whose terrifying image, paradoxically, protects against the demoness Lamashtu.

figures.name: Nanna (Akkadian)

ability.name: Lord of Destinies
ability.description: Adjust one ally's fate: increase any one of their stats by 3 permanently.

figures.description: The moon god worshipped at the great ziggurat of Ur, considered king of the gods in the Akkadian period.

figures.name: Dumuzi (Akkadian)

ability.name: Seasonal Descent
ability.description: Sacrifice 2 HP to restore 4 HP to any ally from the seasonal cycle.

figures.description: The Akkadian shepherd god who dies to save Ishtar and rises from the underworld to bring the spring.

figures.name: Anunnaki (Akkadian)

ability.name: Seven Great Gods
ability.description: All enemies are judged simultaneously: each loses 1 of their highest stat.

figures.description: The Akkadian seven great gods who sit as judges of fate and whose decrees are absolute.

figures.name: Lamassu

ability.name: Gate Guardian
ability.description: Prevent all enemy entry and ambush abilities; block one direct attack against allies.

figures.description: The great winged bull with human head that guarded the gates of Akkadian palaces against all evil.

figures.name: Rabisu

ability.name: Door Lurk
ability.description: Ambush: deal 4 damage to one enemy who was not expecting this card this turn.

figures.description: The crouching demon who lurks at doorways and in dark corners, waiting to ambush the unwary.

figures.name: Humbaba (Akkadian)

ability.name: Terror Breath
ability.description: Inflict fear on all enemies: they cannot advance or charge for 1 turn.

figures.description: The Akkadian version of the Cedar Forest guardian whose face of coiling intestines causes primordial fear.

figures.name: Etana (Akkadian)

ability.name: Sky Rider
ability.description: Attack from above: bypass all ground defenses and deal 4 damage.

figures.description: The Akkadian first king who rode an eagle toward heaven seeking the plant of birth for his childless queen.

figures.name: Bullheaded Lyre Spirit

ability.name: Royal Music
ability.description: Remove all confusion effects; grant +2 wisdom to all allies from divine music.

figures.description: The spirit of the great bull-headed lyre from Ur whose divine music accompanied sacred ceremonies.

figures.name: Edimmu

ability.name: Restless Haunting
ability.description: Inflict haunting on one enemy: they lose 1 power per turn as the spirit drains them.

figures.description: The restless dead who were improperly buried and who haunt the living causing disease and nightmares.

figures.name: Nabu (Akkadian)

ability.name: Stylus of Fate
ability.description: Rewrite one stat: permanently change one enemy's power or defense by -2.

figures.description: The Akkadian god of scribes and the divine writer whose stylus records all fates on the Tablets of Destiny.

figures.name: Sennacherib

ability.name: Imperial Will
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to one enemy; that enemy cannot rebuild destroyed abilities for 1 turn.

figures.description: The great Assyrian king of Akkadian succession whose dream of empire and pride became legendary cautionary tale.

figures.name: Isum

ability.name: Night Fire
ability.description: Prevent all dark ambush abilities; restore 1 HP to all allies from the night fire's warmth.

figures.description: The fire god who walked the night streets protecting the city and who alone could calm the violent Erra.

figures.name: Shulgi

ability.name: King of Ur
ability.description: All Mesopotamian allies gain +2 to their lowest stat from royal patronage.

figures.description: The Akkadian-period king of Ur who deified himself and became the patron of scribes, athletes and divine law.
